report_name: Gîtes de France Breach Data Added to Have I Been Pwned

threat_actors.name: ChimeraZ
threat_actors.description: A hacker who claimed responsibility for the May 2026 data breach at Gîtes de France. ChimeraZ has been linked to other attacks on French tourism companies and likely offered the exfiltrated data for sale on underground forums.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for subsequent sale or use.

identities.name: Gîtes de France
identities.description: A French holiday rental network that suffered a data breach in May 2026, exposing the personal and booking information of hundreds of thousands of customers.

identities.name: Gîtes de France Customers
identities.description: Customers of Gîtes de France whose personal data was exposed in the May 2026 data breach. The exposed data included 117,574 unique email addresses, names, phone numbers, physical addresses, and booking details.
